Wellhead_Pressure_psi: All personnel cleared from high-pressure treating iron area; wellhead valves closed.
Pressurized surface treating lines to 10500 psi to verify integrity and PRV settings.
Equalized surface pressure to 2450 psi and opened hydraulic master and crown valves.
Launched isolation frac ball and pumped slickwater at 15 bpm to seat ball on bridge plug.
Pressure spike to 5650 psi confirmed frac ball seated and isolated current stage.
Pumped 15% HCl acid with corrosion inhibitor at 20 bpm to clear cement and perforation debris.
Treating pressure peaked at 7850 psi and dropped sharply to 6100 psi as shale fractured.
Ramped injection rate to 85 bpm with sand-free slickwater to initiate and propagate fracture network.
Engaged blender sand delivery at 0.5 ppg 100-mesh sand to enter far-field hairline fractures.
Stepped up 100-mesh sand concentration to 1.0 ppg while maintaining 85 bpm clean rate.
Stepped up 100-mesh sand to 1.5 ppg and initiated dry persulfate breaker feed at 0.2 ppg.
Transitioned to 0.5 ppg 100-mesh plus 1.5 ppg 40/70-mesh sand; increased dry breaker to 0.4 ppg.
Switched exclusively to coarser 40/70-mesh sand at 2.5 ppg to pack mid-fracture conductivity.
Pumped final high-concentration 3.0 ppg 40/70-mesh tail-in with 1.0 ppg breaker to reinforce near-wellbore.
Stopped proppant delivery and began clean water flush to displace remaining slurry out of casing.
Sequentially ramped down high-horsepower pump trucks as flush volume approached wellbore capacity.
All pumps offline; recorded Instantaneous Shut-In Pressure (ISIP) of 5420 psi.
Closed hydraulic master valves, bled surface treating iron to 110 psi, and handed off to wireline.
